name: Hex Tile
desc: A glazed hexagonal tile floor running away to the vanishing point — a true honeycomb of flat glossy tops set in recessed grout, with a broad specular reflection band sliding across the glaze as an overhead light drifts; ceramic gloss, speckled terrazzo, dark edge-lit neon, matte slate, or a cyan setting-out plan.

energy.doc: master amplitude — reflection-sweep brightness and the rate the floor streams toward you

scale.doc: hex size in world units — min a fine honeycomb of small tiles, max huge slabs

gloss.doc: glaze specularity — how mirror-bright the reflection band reads on the tile tops

speed.doc: how fast the floor streams toward the viewer

grout.doc: grout channel width — thin hairline joints at min, fat recessed gaps at max

x.doc: vanishing point x as a canvas fraction

y.doc: horizon y as a canvas fraction — everything above stays fully transparent so the bg shows through

style.doc: aesthetic: glossy glazed ceramic with a mirror sweep / matte speckled terrazzo aggregate / dark tiles with glowing edge-lit grout channels / dark matte riven slate / a cyan setting-out plan, hexes as pure line

seed.doc: tile lottery — per-hex tone and shimmer phase
